name: Dividing Gods Land
overview: God established an everlasting covenant with Abraham and his descendants, promising them the land of Canaan as a perpetual possession, as seen in Genesis 15:18 and 17:7-8. This land, though given to Abraham's seed, ultimately belongs to the LORD, who declares that the people are but strangers and sojourners on it (Leviticus 25:23). The divine instructions for dividing the land were communicated through Moses (Numbers 34:1), underscoring God's sovereign authority over His promises. Furthermore, the restoration of Judah and Jerusalem points to God's faithfulness in fulfilling His covenantal promises (Joel 3:1).
